Rita taps one button, the laptop screen turns green, she throws her arms up happily. Mostly locked camera. Characters act with their whole bodies; their designs, faces, clothes and colours never change. No new characters, no text appears.

Max nods once and points down at the bottom of the frame. Locked camera, fixed shot. Every character keeps the same face, body, clothes and colours. Nothing new appears, no text appears. Everyone returns to the starting pose at the end.
